business_summary: BOMESC Offshore Engineering Company Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for offshore oil and gas industries. The company provides design and construction EPC services for electronic modules, life modules, chemical injection modules, sledges, ocean engineering modules, and modules used in LNG mining, refinery, and chemical plants. It also engages in the resource fabrication yard, project management, design, and procurement activities. In addition, the company offers marine engineering and platform equipment; marine engineering design; production equipment manufacturing ; deep-sea oil drilling equipment manufacturing; real estate leasing; instruments and meters; metal materials; engineering supervision; steel structure design; ship-related technology development and technical services; warehousing and import/export of goods; agency services; asset and investment management; investment, financial, economic and business information, and enterprise management consulting; enterprise management; enterprise marketing planning; and equity investment enterprises management. Further, it provides technical services, technology development, technical consulting, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion; new energy power equipment; general mechanical equipment installation; special equipment repair; metal structure; port cargo loading and unloading activities; ship port; general cargo warehousing; general services; operational performance assessment services; energy storage technology services; energy performance contracting; and energy conservation management services. The company operates in China, Brazil, the Middle East, the North Sea, Africa, Southeast Asia, Mexico, Australia, North and South America, Russia, Singapore, and others. BOMESC Offshore Engineering Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: BOMESC Offshore Engineering Company Limited는 해양 석유 및 가스 산업을 위한 엔지니어링, 조달 및 건설(EPC) 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 전자 모듈, 생활 모듈, 화학물질 주입 모듈, 썰매, 해양 엔지니어링 모듈, LNG 채굴, 정유, 화학 플랜트에 사용되는 모듈에 대한 설계 및 시공 EPC 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 자원 제작 야드, 프로젝트 관리, 설계 및 조달 활동에도 참여합니다. 또한 이 회사는 해양 엔지니어링 및 플랫폼 장비를 제공합니다. 해양 공학 설계; 생산 장비 제조 ; 심해 석유 시추 장비 제조; 부동산 임대; 기기 및 미터; 금속재료; 엔지니어링 감독; 강철 구조물 설계; 선박에 관한 기술개발 및 기술용역 물품 보관 및 수입/수출; 대행사 서비스; 자산 및 투자 관리; 투자, 금융, 경제 및 비즈니스 정보, 기업 경영 컨설팅; 기업 관리; 기업 마케팅 계획; 및 지분 투자 기업 관리. 또한 기술 서비스, 기술 개발, 기술 컨설팅을 제공합니다.
